dl_dir.title: Choose download folder
dl_dir.intro_help:
Match the file name against the CivitAI page:
· All-in-one checkpoint (SD/SDXL/Pony, 2-7 GB) -> checkpoints
· Main weights (Flux/Wan/Qwen/Z-Image ...) -> diffusion_models
· VAE (name often has vae/ae, a few hundred MB) -> vae
· Text encoder (t5 / umt5 / clip_l / qwen) -> text_encoders
· Image encoder (clip_vision) -> clip_vision
· GGUF-quantised main weights -> unet_gguf
A file in the wrong folder never shows up in ComfyUI.
